1.

Ah, teach us better to know Thee, God’s holy Lamb, who didst take God’s judgment and all our guilt upon Thee, Thy grace for us is sufficient.

2.

O, may we ever count now What we on earth have received As of no value compared to Thee, Our inheritance, our portion!

3.

Ah, tell how Thou hast loved us, How Thou dost still love us, And let us remember all the days Thou art and wilt remain our Friend.

4.

Write this into our heart, That we may not forget it, But show that we belong to Thee For time and eternity.
